== Strategy ==

First Turn pull a docking bay, preferably executor in planning for Suba. Then Pull Wakeelmui for more force later. While you are fishing around look for the emperor's power also, and throw that down if possible. If you didn't get a decent hand or you opponent didn't give you much force, draw or deploy the Emperor if you can (from deck). Usually you will have a main and a garrison in you hand, two big powers. Second Turn grab another bay and throw both down (main/garrison) if possible. If they seem to not be playing much jedi sack the Hide forever and deploy legion of my best, if they are, keep it, it helps.

Basic Highlights:

Deep Hatred is an auto-loss for your duel with Luke if you wanna cross him, or an auto-win if you like the 3 force loss.

The starships are for quick hits with pilots. If you need to, drop the virtual vader on a ship or shuttle up at tattoine/naboo/wherever for added destruction, and Fett helps up there also. If they play massive space, make them fight for their drains, and use battle order/imp decree. Massively overpower lone characters whenever possible, and deploy docking bays every turn. Lieutenant Suba drops the garrisons for free, and you can pull the tactical support with him (on DS one). The Squad Leader keeps movement costs small enough. Sim aloo and the Prophetess helps you partially fix opponent's destiny, keep them with the emperor. If they try to use colo claw fish to get some high destiny rolling, use the aqua monster to cancel that. The new blaster Rack is just good for this and other main's decks. Against LSC they usually only drop a jedi and a character, so kill them. Against EBO, drop as soon as you can, and move in. WYS will have trouble, because with this deck you usually draw 2 destiny also.

Good Luck and Have Fun. PLEASE RATE SO I CAN MAKE CORRECTIONS

Repost: Dropped a stick for maul and the intruder missile and added some janus grejatus x2. Thanks to psyokid for the review so I could make corrections in time. (“Janus is a beast")

Mod: Thanks to Mare Tino for the rating, dropped artillery for another Suba and DS: DB for executor's. Dropped a Janus for a Dark Jedi Presence (totally forgot about that interrupt).

BHBM is not at all weak, first of all, you get the 2 awesome effects Your destiny (3 force a turn when vader is at a battleground and luke ain't) and Insignificant Rebellion, when you win a battle thay lose an additional force, enough of that can win a game. Plus if you win 3 or 4 battles, and they let you flip your obj. and u have deep hatred out, stack a 1 and a 2 or something and you have automatically crossed Luke to teh Dark Side, so bite me if you don't like the single fact that you have to lose a force a turn.
